desc: This is the OEM front flip sight that is equipped on the KRISS Vector SMG. This sight is extremely low profile, designed to tuck completely out of vision when folded, sitting a mere 12.7mm above the rail surface. The KRISS Low Profile Steel Front Sight features a very wide range of elevation adjustment, accommodating for a large spectrum of firearms with various height over bore and sight radius measurements. Finally, the large, textured, adjustment knob makes elevation changes with gloves simple and easy.
